item.title: KYOGO RETURN? ‘IN A HEARTBEAT,’ ADMITS CELTIC GOAL HERO
item.description: KYOGO FURUHASHI was again left out of Birmingham City’s starting line-up in their 1-1 Boxing Day stalemate against Derby County at St Andrews. The former Celtic fans’ favourite, who fired in 85 goals at the Hoops between arriving in July 2021 and leaving in January this year, has struggled since his £10million exit to Rennes. [...]

item.title: CONFIRMED: SINISALO IN, SCHMEICHEL MISSING
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY has called in Viljami Sinisalo to replace Kasper Schmeichel against Livingston in West Lothian this afternoon. The Danish keeper drops out of the squad with the Finnish international taking over and Ross Doohan on the substitutes’ bench.
